summary: Marketing landing page for Nimbus project management software, designed to convert visitors with a hero section, interactive board preview, and feature highlights.

stack.name: React + Vite
stack.why: Provides fast component development and easy bundling for marketing sites.

stack.name: Tailwind CSS
stack.why: Enables rapid styling with clean utility classes matching the modern SaaS aesthetic.

components.name: Navbar
components.purpose: Displays brand logo, navigation links, and auth buttons.

components.name: HeroSection
components.purpose: Presents the main value proposition, badge, CTA buttons, and Kanban preview image.

components.name: FeatureCard
components.purpose: Highlights key product features with an icon, title, and descriptive text.

components.name: Footer
components.purpose: Contains copyright information and legal/contact links.

steps.title: Initialize Project
steps.detail: Set up a new React and Vite project, install Tailwind CSS, and configure base fonts and colors in the CSS config.

steps.title: Build Navbar
steps.detail: Create the header component with the Nimbus logo, navigation links (Features, Pricing, etc.), Log in button, and Start free trial button.

steps.title: Construct Hero Section
steps.detail: Build the left-hand text column with the 'New · Sprint reports' badge, main heading, description paragraph, and CTA buttons. Add the Kanban board preview graphic to the right column.

steps.title: Create Feature Cards Grid
steps.detail: Implement a responsive 3-column grid below the hero section containing the Shared boards, Deadline alerts, and Sprint reports feature cards.

steps.title: Build Footer
steps.detail: Add the bottom footer with copyright text and links for Privacy, Terms, and Contact.

steps.title: Refine Styling and Spacing
steps.detail: Fine-tune margins, padding, rounded corners, shadows on the kanban preview container, and typography weights to match the clean SaaS design.

steps.title: Responsive Checks
steps.detail: Test layout scaling across mobile and desktop breakpoints to ensure columns stack correctly and text remains legible.

behaviour: Log in button: Navigates user to the application authentication page.
Start free trial buttons: Open a registration modal or redirect to the signup flow.
Book a demo button: Opens a scheduling modal or redirects to a booking page.
Navigation links: Smooth scroll to page sections or navigate to dedicated subpages.
data: navigation_links: array of labels and URLs for features, pricing, customers, and docs
features_list: array of objects containing icon, title, and description for the bottom grid cards
